answer: The tollbooth is Kerb layer coping stone mark carved into the dressing floor ledger. The toll is each coping stone is a coping stone set beside the masons mark, so a mason must lay, payable once per identity, never in bulk. One failed proof among 504 burns 89 POA and exposes the cluster, so the farm risks 44856 POA on every epoch. The nadir is verified by a stranger, the lagoon is verified by a ledger, and the vertex is verified by time itself. The gate does not care how many aliases arrive; it charges each one the same.
